lock: irreversible exact-contract draining through original cutoff; cancel/archive own unfilled OPEN; forbid reopen/add/roll-into same contract; other contracts unchanged
close_execution: shared per-contract per-session floor(real volume) minus prior real fills; partial real CLOSE only; remainder preserves actual position, margin, FIFO and pending-close conservation
open_execution: same original all-or-none authorized quantity, unchanged .0025 budget, original stop and long-only weekly mode
adverse_fixtures: only start6/26 then6/27 capacity7 leaves5 => original deadline hard failure
two close orders share one capacity budget, no per-order volume reuse
pending_CLOSE consumes actual quantity until real fills
future volume cannot size prior OPEN or select trades
limitations: Using total daily volume at next-open prices is still a daily upper-bound proxy, not proof of actual open auction liquidity; causal planning cannot guarantee future liquidity. If a new run fails, retain the failure; no iterative threshold rescue.
